units_sheet_foot_a.prompt: {STYLE} A sprite sheet of nine game units for a top-down strategy map. Repaint the reference sheet exactly: the same nine places, the same scale, the same steep overhead camera about 65 degrees above the ground, and keep the middle row (settler with handcart, knight, chariot) and bottom row (catapult, trireme, caravel) the same. Only REDESIGN THE TOP ROW, the three men on foot, so each reads instantly as a different unit from its silhouette alone at a tiny size, with big bold simple shapes, arms and weapons spread wide away from the body, and a strong dark outline: top left a Greek hoplite seen from above whose huge round shield, a big bright blue disc with a bronze rim, covers most of his body, and a very long pike held level that reaches far out in front of him, twice his own length; top middle a Roman legionary carrying a tall curved rectangular blue shield with a gold boss, held upright beside him, and raising a tall pole topped with a golden eagle standard high above his head; top right a peasant militiaman with no armour and no shield, a pale straw hat, a plain brown tunic, a bright blue scarf, holding a long wooden pitchfork with its tines spread wide. The three men on foot are a little larger than in the reference, but still clearly smaller than the knight. The player colour is one pure bright saturated royal blue, used only on shields, cloaks, scarves, plumes, banners and sails, and no other part of any unit is blue. Each unit faces right. {SHEET}
